readerCopy.summary: The people celebrating rapid innovation face the communities dealing with its costs.
readerCopy.body: The people celebrating rapid innovation face the communities dealing with its costs. One side points to access, opportunity, and a market that cannot be slowed; the other points to displacement, unstable prices, lost work, and rules that arrived after the damage. Jupiter holds the promise of expansion, while Uranus gives the break from the old system enough force to make reversal unlikely. The opposition places new freedom across from the people whose stability financed it. The reform may continue, but the argument reveals who was included in the future and who was simply expected to adjust.
